thread:
Sam: quick heads-up — after yesterday's kernel roll we started seeing p95 jitter on a subset of T2 routes (mostly convo-chat and large-context summarization). looks like batch formation time increased for short queries.
Anya: ugh. saw a spike in queueing for routes with token budgets < 64? could be microbatch alignment mismatch with the new fused-attn kernel.
Priya: I profiled a few requests and KV cache hit latency is fine, but prefix coalescing is causing more partial batches. attaching a tiny snippet of the perf diff: `alloc_time +26ms, kernel_launch -3ms, overall p95 +18ms`
Mike: can you paste the tracer stack when that happens? we need to know whether the delay is in admission (queue policy) vs kernel scheduling.
Sam: pasted minimal logs below — note the queue drain shows many 1-3 token requests held waiting to fill a batch then timing out to meet tail SLO.
Sam: ```
[queue] admit req route=convo-chat len=20 budget=32 waiting=42ms
[batcher] microbatch formed size=3 tokens=74 kernel=fused-attn-v2
[kernel] launch latency=4ms
[serv] total p95=82ms
```
Anya: hypothesis: the new kernel prefers larger homogeneous microbatches, so it signals higher kernel throughput but amplifies admission wait for small requests. dynamic token budgets per route/tier could avoid holding tiny requests too long.
Priya: agreed. propose a small heuristic: - for routes with p95 > target and median token len < 64, lower target token budget and enable aggressive queue gating (max_hold_ms=20) - for large-context routes, keep budget higher to get kernel perf wins.
Mike: we should also add a guard for KV-cache churn: if prefix_kv_hit_rate drops below 70% during canary, relax batching to avoid extra cache misses.
Sam: plan: 1) run a canary that modulates token_budget_by_route: convo-chat=24, summarization-large=128. 2) enable queue gating for small routes. 3) collect tracer + kv-hit metrics. 4) fallback to previous kernel after 1 hour if p95 regresses > 10%.
Anya: can we implement the canary as a route-tier policy so we don't touch global defaults? i can push a config patch today.
Priya: I'll add a quick perf harness to replay representative short queries to the canary cohort. aim: 2k qps replay for 15m + live traffic sampling.
InfraBot: deploy request queued: canary-config/convo-chat-token-budget-20260318 queued by Anya. CI lint OK.
Mike: reminder — include the microbatch distribution histogram in the console dashboard, we want to see fraction of 1-2 token batches.
Sam: thanks. if the canary looks good, next step is to add an automatic controller that adjusts token_budget_by_route every 5m based on p95 gap and kv-hit-rate. simple PID-ish: increase budget if p95 > target and kv-hit > 80%; decrease if p95 < target and median_len low.
Anya: keeping it simple is good. i'll open a PR for route-tier policy + gating and link test plan here.
Priya: dropping a checklist: (1) perf harness + replay config (2) dashboard panels (microbatch histogram, kv-hit-rate, queue_hold_ms) (3) canary config (route overrides) (4) rollback playbook.
Sam: awesome. quick note: let's also log kernel selection hints per-batch so we can correlate fused-attn-v2 wins with admission latency. small telemetry tweak.
Mike: +1. tagging infra to watch for elevated CPU on hosts during the canary.
Anya: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4321 — description and canary YAML included. will request reviews.
Priya: I'll start the harness in 5m and post initial numbers.
Sam: thanks team — aim to evaluate after the 15m run and decide whether to promote or revert. :thumbsup:
